display.purpose: Hero headlines and landing page titles. Space Grotesk only.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, descriptions, form labels. Manrope. Max 65-75ch line length.

label.purpose: Metadata, status indicators, section eyebrows. Uppercase, wide tracking.

shadows.name: elevation-sm
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for buttons at rest, chips, small interactive elements.

shadows.name: elevation-md
shadows.purpose: Cards, raised panels, dropdown triggers on hover.

shadows.name: elevation-lg
shadows.purpose: Glass panels, active modals, dragged elements.

shadows.name: elevation-xl
shadows.purpose: Full-screen overlays, hero elements on landing page.

shadows.name: glass-rim-fire
shadows.purpose: Left-edge thermal glow on glass surfaces. Structural, not decorative.

shadows.name: glass-rim-ice
shadows.purpose: Right-edge thermal glow on glass surfaces. Structural, not decorative.

motion.name: instant
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: toggle, press feedback, tooltip appear.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Button hover/active transitions, border color shifts.

motion.name: normal
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions: panel open, content swap.

motion.name: layout
motion.purpose: Layout shifts: sidebar collapse, panel resize.

motion.name: exit
motion.purpose: Element removal. Faster than entrance for perceived snappiness.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Maximum deceleration for dramatic entrances (brand/marketing only).

components.name: Fire Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Ember gradient with heavy glow. Used for sign-up, split, and export actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-fire { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,180,100,0.3); padding: 15px 19px; color: #fffbf8; font-weight: 600; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.26), transparent 32%), linear-gradient(135deg, #cc2200 0%, #ff5500 35%, #ff8800 65%, #ffbb33 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.32), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0 22px 52px rgba(255,60,10,0.35), 0 0 36px rgba(255,100,30,0.38), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,80,20,0.2); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), filter 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-fire:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); filter: brightness(1.14); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.36), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.18), 0 30px 56px rgba(255,60,10,0.42), 0 0 48px rgba(255,120,40,0.48), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,100,30,0.3); } .ds-btn-fire:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 40px rgba(255,80,20,0.65), 0 0 60px rgba(255,60,10,0.35); } .ds-btn-fire:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.32), 0 0 0 2px oklch(7% 0.012 38), 0 0 0 4px oklch(63% 0.21 38); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Ice-tinted transparent with cool glow on hover. Used for sign-in, cancel, and tertiary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.18); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), rgba(255,255,255,0.03)), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,200,255,0.06) 0%, transparent 100%); color: rgba(255,249,244,0.86); padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 500; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(0,220,255,0.55); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.14), rgba(0,200,255,0.14)), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,200,255,0.1) 0%, transparent 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(0,200,255,0.32), inset 0 1px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); box-shadow: 0 0 36px rgba(0,200,255,0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(7% 0.012 38), 0 0 0 4px oklch(63% 0.21 38); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Primary container surface. Glassmorphic with thermal edge glows and prismatic sheen. Used for pricing sections, feature blocks, and content panels.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-left-color: rgba(255,80,20,0.55); border-right-color: rgba(0,200,255,0.5); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.28) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 10%, transparent 28%), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,120,40,0.16) 0%, transparent 35%), linear-gradient(315deg, rgba(0,180,255,0.14) 0%, transparent 35%), oklch(11% 0.014 38 / 74%); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 18px rgba(255,40,0,0.14), inset -4px 0 18px rgba(0,200,255,0.1), -2px 0 0 rgba(255,80,20,0.42), 2px 0 0 rgba(0,200,255,0.38), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.42), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(200%) brightness(1.1); } .ds-glass-panel-text { color: oklch(96% 0.012 75); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Dark solid background, subtle border, warm placeholder text.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: oklch(20% 0.015 40); border: 1px solid oklch(32% 0.016 42 / 55%); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: oklch(96% 0.012 75); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(70% 0.013 50); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(63% 0.21 38); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(7% 0.012 38), 0 0 0 4px oklch(63% 0.21 38 / 40%); }

components.name: Stem Toggle
components.description: Stem lane mute/solo toggle. Activates with stem-specific color and glow. Always paired with a text label.
components.css: .ds-stem-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); padding: 8px 14px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); position: relative; } .ds-stem-toggle::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; } .ds-stem-toggle--active { color: oklch(65% 0.24 350); border-color: oklch(65% 0.24 350); box-shadow: 0 0 20px oklch(65% 0.24 350 / 44%), 0 0 40px rgba(255,132,92,0.09); } .ds-stem-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(65% 0.24 350); box-shadow: 0 0 10px oklch(65% 0.24 350 / 44%); } .ds-stem-toggle--active .ds-stem-dot { box-shadow: 0 0 16px oklch(65% 0.24 350), 0 0 24px oklch(65% 0.24 350 / 44%); } .ds-stem-label { letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Section eyebrow text. Uppercase, wide-tracked, muted warm tone. Used above section headings.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.34em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,243,229,0.45); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Where raw audio is heated, shaped, and cooled into something refined. Fire is creation, energy, action. Ice is control, precision, information. The interface is the forge itself: dark, hot at the edges, responsive to touch, and built to run all night.

This system rejects sterile corporate SaaS aesthetics, sketchy freeware energy, and bare-bones developer minimalism with equal force. It also refuses the one-trick-pony trap: every surface communicates workflow depth, not single-action utility. The visual language draws from iZotope's spectral precision, Linear's kinetic snappiness, Splice's organized density, and FabFilter's fluid interactivity.

The result is a dark, immersive environment that feels like sitting down at an expensive piece of studio hardware that happens to live in a browser tab.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only. No light mode. The forge runs hot in a dim room.
Thermal color encoding: warm hues = action/energy/CTA; cool hues = tool chrome/information/secondary.
Glassmorphic surfaces with prismatic sheens and thermal edge glows, used structurally.
Compact, high-density layouts inspired by hardware channel strips and DAW mixers.
Exponential ease-out curves (quart/quint/expo). No bounce, no elastic, no spring.
OKLCH color space throughout. Neutrals tinted to brand hue. Never pure gray.

rules.name: The Thermal Encoding Rule
rules.body: Warm hues (ember, gold) mean action, energy, user-initiated. Cool hues (ice, frost) mean information, system-state, tool chrome. Mixing these semantics is forbidden.

rules.name: The Never-Pure Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff, no chroma-0 grays anywhere in the system. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand hue (ember 38°) at chroma 0.005-0.014.

rules.name: The Stem Distinction Rule
rules.body: Stem lane colors are chosen for luminance AND temperature separation. A deuteranopic user must distinguish every lane by brightness alone. Color is never the sole identifier.

rules.name: The Fluid Scale Rule
rules.body: All type sizes use clamp() for fluid scaling. No breakpoint-driven font-size jumps. The scale flows; it never snaps.

rules.name: The DAW Exception Rule
rules.body: Inside the mixer/editor workspace, typography switches to system UI at 10-13px. Deliberate density mode for the tool surface.

rules.name: The State-Driven Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are tonally layered at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state: hover lifts, drag elevates, focus rings glow.

rules.name: The Thermal Rim Rule
rules.body: Glass panels carry fire (left) and ice (right) edge glows as structural orientation markers. Not decorative borders.

dos: Do use OKLCH for all color definitions. Reduce chroma as lightness approaches 0 or 100.
Do tint every neutral toward ember hue 38° at chroma 0.005-0.014.
Do maintain 4.5:1 contrast ratio minimum for all text.
Do use exponential ease-out curves (quart/quint/expo) for all transitions.
Do ensure every interactive element has a minimum 44×44px tap target.
Do pair every stem lane color with a persistent text label or icon.
Do show workflow depth on every surface.
Do use the thermal axis consistently: fire/warm = left, action; ice/cool = right, information.
donts: Don't use flat white backgrounds, generic blue primaries, or corporate illustrations.
Don't use flashing buttons, intrusive banners, or anything resembling a free MP3 converter.
Don't leave surfaces unstyled with system fonts and raw gray backgrounds.
Don't reduce any view to just an upload box and a button.
Don't use border-left/right > 1px as colored accent stripes.
Don't use bounce, elastic, or spring easing.
Don't use modals as the first solution.
